status: not-run as a set. Nothing here is a measured misroute rate; the build session runs routing after the merge.
use: Copy `cases` into a westack-eval routing campaign (kind routing) and register it before any description is tuned. The split is fixed here: score the held-out cases once per description version; scoring them against a changed description turns them into dev cases.
population_needed: Names in `expect` must be in the campaign's population: westack-security, westack-review, westack-debug and westack-verify from this repository. The user's real population also holds gstack's /cso, the host's /security-review command and installed review plugins, the likeliest competitors for security requests; keep them in. A request that names /security-review or /cso expects NONE from a model-invoked router: the named command runs.
pending_note: westack-ci is planned, not built: n07 carries pending_until_built, so leave it out of a campaign until that skill exists (its expectation stays; never relabel it), then delete the marker.
